cumleler: Why can taste change after ear surgery?
The facial nerve descends deep in the middle ear's back wall.
Its branch, the chorda tympani, crosses the middle ear near the eardrum.
This thin nerve carries taste from the front of the tongue.
Taste changes sometimes seen after surgery are linked to this nerve.
